comparison.objective: Support a trailer tongue, roll a heavy rover under it, and lower the coupler onto the ball; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated load support, vehicle translation, and coupler alignment/insertion differ from small-tool insertion, fine collar rotation, and fastener torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Trailer must be hitched after controlled support and lowering; the record omits alignment, latch, support, and damage thresholds. Candidate requires repeated safe impacts and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Although both involve bimanual force control, hitch alignment and load transfer are meaningfully different.
